import json,pathlib,hashlib,time,resource
P=pathlib.Path('plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification'); R=P/'reports/phase-08'
m=json.loads((P/'reports/doc-inventory.json').read_text()); start=time.monotonic(); total=hashlib.sha256(); count=0; seen=0; rows=[]; in_array=False; complete=False; buf=[]; parts=[]
selected=set(json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/fgos-work/step02c-population.json').read_text()))
def wanted(p):
 return p in selected
for part in m['parts']:
 h=hashlib.sha256(); size=0
 with (P/'reports'/part['path']).open('rb') as f:
  for raw in f:
   h.update(raw);total.update(raw);size+=len(raw);count+=len(raw)
   if complete: continue
   l=raw.decode()
   if not in_array:
    if l.rstrip()=='  "consumerEdges": [': in_array=True
    continue
   if l.rstrip()=='  ],': complete=True;continue
   if l.startswith('    {'):buf=[l];continue
   if buf:
    buf.append(l)
    if l.rstrip() in ['    },','    }']:
     e=json.loads(''.join(buf).rstrip().rstrip(','));seen+=1
     if wanted(e.get('path','')):rows.append(e)
     buf=[]
 assert size==part['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==part['sha256'],part['path']
 parts.append({'path':part['path'],'bytes':size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()})
assert complete and not buf and count==m['totalBytes'] and total.hexdigest()==m['sha256']
out=R/'step-02c-inventory-edges.json';out.write_text(json.dumps({'selection':'Consumer path in maps/portals/maintained prose population; includes unresolved-dynamic-pattern entries. Other classes deliberately excluded. Existing metadata only; no .fgos/state file opened.','inventoryCommit':'2a028cdc930c47ce207b64ab7d9e1a8a8ec295b4','entries':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
receipt={'command':'/usr/bin/time -v env -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID python3 /tmp/fgos-work/step02c-export.py','method':'ordered line streaming; hash each part and full concat; JSON-decode one consumerEdge at a time; retain selected consumer paths only','manifest':str(P/'reports/doc-inventory.json'),'manifestSha256':hashlib.sha256((P/'reports/doc-inventory.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'inputBytes':count,'inputSha256':total.hexdigest(),'verifiedParts':len(parts),'allConsumerEdges':seen,'selectedConsumerEdges':len(rows),'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'peakRSSKiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'output':str(out),'outputBytes':out.stat().st_size,'outputSha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'parallelHeavyJobs':0,'parts':parts}
(R/'step-02c-inventory-export.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k!='parts'},indent=2))
